## s08-v07 — argument map

May my self-body bloom (vikasatu svavapur) as You (bhavadātmakaṃ). May worlds join (samupayāntu) my limbs (mamāṅgatām). May all this duality-sport (sarvam idaṃ dvayavalgitaṃ), even recalled (smṛtipathopagame 'py), become untellable (anupākhyatām).

### Open
- Whether 'dvayavalgitaṃ' means 'duality-sport' or 'the sport of duality' is unresolved.
- Whether 'anupākhyatām' means 'untellable' or 'unnameable' is unresolved.
